description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Physical Mutation

A gemstone grows in your body, protruding through your esh like an unholy jewel. e crystal is attuned to the Winds of Magic (much like @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.OEjUvJKi0xmBwbS2]{Second Sight}) and will change colour and intensity depending on which winds are prevailing in the environment. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.6w30u0VPsAicrqb5]{Magical Sense} Talent, although you have to be able to see how your crystal behaves in order for it to work. Being near or touching a magic-user will make the gemstone glow brighter in their chosen Wind. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.g3y373FnWJEAxgEB]{Detect Artefact} Talent. Nearing a magical item will make your crystal glow stronger and by touching it you may try to determine its powers. Unfortunately the crystal functions as a conduit for magic and you have -10 to all Opposed Tests versus incoming spells. You can only gain this mutation once.
